services.title: Gau Chara Seva
services.benefit: Helps reduce Surya Dosh & brings confidence & success.
services.detailedDescription: Fresh, juicy green grass, sorghum, and clover harvested early morning and offered with sacred devotion to Gaumata in certified Vedic goshalas.
services.vedicSignificance: According to the Bhavishya Purana, feeding fresh green fodder to Kamadhenu pleases Lord Surya, dispelling lethargy and opening paths to authority and respect.

services.title: Gau Roti Seva
services.benefit: Helps calm Chandra Dosh & brings peace of mind.
services.detailedDescription: Pure whole-wheat rotis freshly prepared with pure desi ghee and love, hand-fed to maternal cows while reciting auspicious cow-benedictions.
services.vedicSignificance: Chandra (Moon) controls the psyche and emotional wellbeing. Offering warm rotis soothes mental afflictions, anxiety, and sleeplessness.

services.title: Gau Gud-Chana Seva
services.benefit: Helps reduce Mangal Dosh & brings courage & strength.
services.detailedDescription: Rich organic mineral jaggery (Gud) and dry-roasted protein-rich gram (Chana), formulated to build vigor and vitality for cows and calves.
services.vedicSignificance: Pacifies fiery Mars (Mangal). Recommended by astrologers for clearing debts, removing legal hurdles, and pacifying Manglik Dosha.

services.title: Pakshi Dana Seva
services.benefit: Helps remove Mangal Dosh & brings courage & strength.
services.detailedDescription: Wholesome natural pearl millets (bajra), broken wheat, flaxseeds, and water bowls distributed at sunrise for wild sparrows, doves, and parrots.
services.vedicSignificance: Mercury (Budh) governs speech, business acumen, and intellect. Birds are symbols of divine communication; feeding them brings clarity and prosperous trade.

services.title: Cheenti Aata Seva
services.benefit: Helps reduce Rahu-Ketu Dosh & brings stability.
services.detailedDescription: Sacred sweet Kasar powder composed of dry roasted wheat flour, powdered sugar, and sesame seeds, placed near ant colonies under holy Peepal and Banyan trees.
services.vedicSignificance: Feeding innumerable tiny souls (cheentis) balances karmic debits, neutralizes sudden shocks, and stabilizes unpredictable Rahu-Ketu cycles.

services.title: Street Dogs Seva
services.benefit: Helps remove Ketu Dosh & brings spiritual growth.
services.detailedDescription: Wholesome hygienic meals cooked with rice, turmeric, boiled milk, pumpkin, and rotis, distributed compassionately to stray street animals.
services.vedicSignificance: The dog represents the faithful vahana of Lord Bhairava and Lord Dattatreya. Feeding stray dogs shields families from evil eye, black magic, and Ketu obstacles.
